description: It truly is fascinating what the human mind can accomplish, and in a field as vast as interstellar exploration, where we are fueled primarily by our curiosity, our pursuit of knowledge is infinite. Inspired by the endless unknown, I have strived for years to understand as much as I can about our universe and connect the dots between every element that make up the world we live in.
summary: A hand-drawn story, inspired by the style of 80's arcade games, about a spaceship that has lost its way home. With no information about its whereabouts, it must seek any help it may find in the vastness of space. Along the way it will meet fellow space travelers and learn their history and missions, and take what advice and lessons they have to offer. Perhaps by the time you complete your journey, you will have learned way more than just how to get home.
details:
What better way to make long a complicated data interesting than turn into an interactive story? Here, I hand drew a retro-arcade style story in which the viewer can help a lost spaceship gather clues from the travelers they meet along the way. Hence turning written data into an animated that simplifies the complex facts related to previous space missions. This way audience of varying ages can learn and explore these missions in a fun and summarized way.
For this project I used the app 'Procreate' on an Ipad along with an apple pencil, 'Capcut' on desktop for audio effects and animation, PowerPoint to piece everything together and Microsoft Word to write down the manuscript.

(Please open in PowerPoint and view using the slideshow mode)
